changelog.change: Expanded needs property max bounds to 200.000000 in agent.json schema
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: In TEST-304, hunger reached 100.8 before AR_02_MORTALITY executed, causing PropertyValueOutOfBoundsError before mortality could execute cleanly

changelog.change: Added age property to agent.json entity schema (INT64, min 0, max 500000)
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Layer 1 ecosystem rules (BR_03_BASAL_METABOLISM) iterate over cell_entities and query age, causing UnknownPropertyError when agents share cells with ecosystem entities

changelog.change: Clamped reproduction_drive increment with reproduction_drive <= 99.0 precondition in AR_01_METABOLISM
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Unmated agents accumulated reproduction_drive past the schema maximum of 200.0, causing PropertyValueOutOfBoundsError

changelog.change: Restricted mate candidate search in AR_05_REPRODUCE to max_scan: 3 and tightened pre-filter (sex == 1, action_taken == 0, biomass >= 20.0, energy >= 30.0)
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Multi-agent candidate evaluations exceeded the 256 GRL operation budget per cell (257 > 256), triggering QuotaExceededError. Also updated reproduction_min_biomass to 20.0 and reproduction_min_energy to 30.0

changelog.change: Added explicit parent_biomass_deduction (15.0) and parent_energy_deduction (25.0) in reproduction parameters
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Declared explicit per-parent somatic deductions matching AR_05_REPRODUCE effects (15.0x2 = 30.0 child biomass, 25.0x2 = 50.0 child energy)
Motivated by test results: Energy yield of 15.0 was insufficient to sustain metabolic needs and allow reproduction drive accumulation without entering starvation
Motivated by test results: Prevents agents from accumulating high fatigue before resting, ensuring stable circadian sleep/wake cycles

changelog.change: Increased target_selector_limit from 2 to 4 in budget_guards
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Allowed up to 4 agents to execute actions per cell without starving crowded cells

changelog.change: Removed locomotion energy deduction from AR_07_FORAGE_MOVE, keeping metabolic_rate as sole energy drain
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: In TEST-304, wandering agents exhausted energy at tick 58 instead of within the pre-registered [95, 105] starvation window

changelog.change: Calibrated TEST-307 spatial distribution (18 agents across 3x3 grid) and plant carrying capacity (cap 15.0, replenishment 1.0)
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Placing 16 agents at (0, 0) caused single-cell operation congestion (263 quota failures) and unbounded population growth without resource limitation

changelog.change: Clarified TEST-306 as resource-bound selection pressure for starvation-resistant low metabolic rate
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Feeding in AR_04_EAT provides flat +40.0 energy regardless of metabolic rate; lower metabolic rate confers starvation resistance with zero somatic trade-off

changelog.change: Added is_agent INT64 property to agent schema (default 1) and ecosystem schemas (default 0) to decouple Layer 2 rules without modifying substrate
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Reverted entities.py modification and decoupled ecosystem rules BR_03 and BR_05 from agents using pure declarative schema properties

changelog.change: Increased drink thirst_satisfaction from 40.000000 to 50.000000 in actions.drink
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Aligned parameters with AR_03_DRINK rule effect to satisfy rule parity tests and prevent premature dehydration under high metabolic rate

changelog.change: Increased reproduction child_base_energy from 40.000000 to 50.000000 in actions.reproduction
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Aligned parameters with AR_05_REPRODUCE rule effect where both parents contribute 25.0 energy to yield 50.0 base energy for offspring

changelog.change: Bumped version to v3 with is_agent schema property and complete parity disclosures
changelog.motivation: Motivated by test results: Frozen specification bumped to v3 to isolate post-approval changes and restore v2 to original Phase 3b pin

description: Frozen pre-registered parameter specification for individual autonomous agents in GENESIS Alpha.

not_applicable_reasons.cultural_spread: Phase 3 agents have no memes, practices, or adoption events.
not_applicable_reasons.group_emergence: Phase 3 agents have no trade, tribute, or political cooperation edges/events. Interaction graph is empty.

mass_and_thermodynamics.energy_explanation: Energy (solar_flux, agent/organism energy) is an open thermodynamic driver driving metabolic transitions and is dissipated as work/heat. It is strictly excluded from closed mass accounting.
mass_and_thermodynamics.overflow_explanation: When feeding intake exceeds available headroom below biomass_cap (500.0), excess assimilated biomass overflows 1:1 directly into environmental detritus, guaranteeing exact zero-leak mass conservation.

phase: Phase 3: Individual Agents as Data (Traits, Needs, Genetics)

gene_boldness.description: Locus 4: Feeding vs resting priority threshold allele. Scaled by 1/100.

gene_fertility.description: Locus 2: Reproduction drive accumulation multiplier allele. Scaled by 1/100.

gene_foraging_range.description: Locus 1: Maximum grid movement step in Chebyshev distance.

gene_longevity.description: Locus 3: Lifespan limit in ticks before senescence death.

gene_metabolic_rate.description: Locus 0: Metabolic rate integer allele. Scaled by 1/100 to produce metabolic_rate trait.

boldness.trade_off: Higher boldness prompts active foraging even at low hunger, spending movement energy to maintain high energy reserves.

fertility.trade_off: Higher fertility accelerates reproduction drive accumulation, but increases risk of maternal exhaustion if biomass and energy are depleted.

foraging_range.trade_off: Larger step range enables reaching distant food patches, but costs proportionately higher movement energy and fatigue per step.

longevity.trade_off: Longer lifespan permits more lifetime reproductive cycles, but accumulates late-life somatic wear.

metabolic_rate.trade_off: Lower metabolic rate reduces hunger accumulation and basal energy burn (starvation resistance), but yields lower energy extraction efficiency from food (0.8x vs 1.2x at high metabolism).
